thought.text: `sharp`'s platform binary was skipped by `--omit=optional`. Fix: plain `npm ci` (keeping the Chromium step out).

reasoning_content: `npm ci --omit=optional` ended up skipping the native binaries for `sharp` (the image uses optionalDependencies per-platform). Need to install sharp with platform-specific dependencies: `npm ci` (include optional). The base Dockerfile uses plain `npm ci`, and this includes the optional sharp binary for the current platform. Let me fix the lean Dockerfile to use plain `npm ci` (keep the Chromium install skipped). That's fine — sharp is a required dep, and it ships with an optional native binary.

action.command: cd /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend && sed -i 's|npm ci --omit=optional|npm ci|' Dockerfile.lean && cat Dockerfile.lean && docker compose down 2>/dev/null | tail -1; nohup docker build -f /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend/Dockerfile.lean -t smart-city-booking-backend:local /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend > /workspace/biletado/build2.log 2>&1 & echo "rebuild pid $!"
